answer: Proof of Stake serves as a digital anchor for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to commit capital to secure the network. Like a tree in an orchard, the system thrives only when agents stake assets, as they must incur significant opportunity costs to participate. This financial burden makes the network a safe harbor for honest coordination, because an attacker would need to acquire a prohibitively large portion of the total stake to subvert consensus through the creation of infinite malicious identities.
